summary: Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV filed a Form 6-K on 16 June 2026 announcing the appointment of Dirk Van de Put as its new Chairman, effective immediately, succeeding Martin J. Barrington who retired at the Annual Shareholders Meeting. Mr. Van de Put, an Independent Director since April 2023 and current Chairman/CEO of Mondelēz International, was unanimously selected by the Board. This is a routine leadership succession, not a forced departure. The event is reported via a press release incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms, advisor, or premium involved. The filing is routine, so a 'Management Changes' categorization is borderline; 'None' may be more appropriate but the explicit new-chairman announcement is the sole event.
